en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Ali Majilawayh, may Allah be pleased with him, from his paternal uncle, Muhammed bin Abi’l-Qasim, from Muhammed bin Ali al-Sayrafi, from Sa’dan bin Muslim, from Hussain bin Na’eem, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:
O Hussain, be generous with the grace. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, and what thing is generosity with it? He said: To attempt doing good with what remains to you.
